review_text: This is by far my favorite moisturizer for my oily skin. I’ve been using it 4 years now and the results are still amazing. So lightweight, yet so moisturizing. It’s literally amazing! I don’ know how they’ve done it. I even use it around my eyes without any irritation.

This was honestly a let down. It didn’t help moisturize my face anymore than the cheap face moisturizer from trader joe’s. The only way I could get it to moisturize my face at all was if i smothered my face with it, but then it made my face look and feel greasy, without actually hydrating it.

I used this because I have sensitive skin, and it did nothing for my face. In fact, my complexion looked a lot more dull when using this, which is a pity as I thought something more ’high end’ would do wonders for my skin. I bet it works well for several people, but personally it did nothing.

I’ve got oily skin and this gel moisturizer is great. Feels light and refreshing and my skin soaks it up pretty quickly. No fragrance which I love because I have sensitive skin, super gentle no complaints here.
Love this gel moisturizer! great for ppl who have oily skin and cant stand the sticky feel of thicker lotions/creams
You dont need a lot, a small amount get’s the job done. Feels light compared to the lotion version.
I’ve tried every moisturizer out there & keep coming back to this one. I use day/night & it makes my skin hydrated, silky & smoothe.
LOVE this product! It works miracles on dry, flaky skin in the middle of winter!

I love love love this lotion. I’ve been using the Clinique 3-step regime for over 3 years and I absolutely swear by these products. The gel lotion is extremely light, but moisturizes well without being oily. Perfect in the Summer! However in the cooler months, my skin requires a bit more moisture so I either switch to the Dramatically Different Moisturizing Lotion, or add Moisture Surge to dry areas.

This moisturizing gel has never failed me. I remember my mom using this when I was in grade school (I’m 27 now) so I tried it... been a loyal user since! It’s so nice for oily skin, absorbs pretty quickly. I rarely use a foundation primer because this makes my skin so nice.
This is the first moisturizer I’ve tried that didn’t feel heavy or make me break out. I use this morning and night, and it has made my skin very soft and smooth.

I love this product from Clinique, i have pretty normal skin and just needed a moisturizer to help hydrate my skin in the morning and qt nite and this product does just that it goes on real light and smooth , it has no funny odor and gives you a cool hydrating feeling as it goes on. very happy with this moisturizer definitely recommend it.

I grabbed this product thinking it was the lotion, and I’m so glad that I did!  The gel works great with my combination skin!  It provides a ton of moisture without clogging my pores. And you can’t beat the price!
It was okay, but not that great. Felt nice to apply, but wasn’t super moisturising sook after
this product is promising (to say the very least)for once i can actually see the skin beneath my problem areas; again, another great investment.<3

I was hesitant about using gel as a moisturizer, but it works better than any facial lotion I’ve ever tried. It absorbs very quickly, doesn’t leave any shine and hydrates my skin incredibly well. My skin feels very soft for a while after I use it. I purchased the small bottle to try it out but will be upgrading soon. Another great thing is that a little goes a long way, so it lasts a while.
I love this oil free gel.  It is hydrating but doesn’t feel heavy or greasy on the skin.  I use it as part of my 3 step skin care twice a day.
I have oily skin and have tried many types of moisturizers and this by far is the best! My skin looks and feels great, doesn’t make my skin shiny.

I love the fact that this is a gel. I have oily skin, so I’m always conscious of the shine effect from some moisturizers. This one keeps my skin smooth and moisturized without turning my face into an oil slick. I actually was using the Clinique 3 step acne system and the ance lotion was a bit drying. I use the gel last or sometimes instead of the lotion if I’m feeling extra dry. This is a terrific product to use under my make-up and under my primer.

I have very sensitive combination skin that is acne prone and has different needs with season changes. I have changed up my moisture routine a lot over the years and almost always at a season change. I have now been using this for over a year and my skin feels wonderful year round using it. Its light, moisturizing, and not oily at all. I finally found “the one“ my skin needs.  Best part is, I bought the 4.2 oz in March, and even with DAILY use, I’m not even 1/3 of the way through the bottle.

I have a dry/oily combination skin, and this gel works wonders. My acne has cleared with the use of this gel, and my other gals who either have oily or incredibly dry sensitive skin have reported that this has really helped. Adefinate buy:)
This moisturizing gel is wonderful for oily skin. I use this daily before applying makeup and it helps to keep my make up fresh all day.

I have been using this product for three years. I am currently in search of another moisturizer because it does not control my oily skin as much as I would like it to. It is perfect for sensitive skin but I am neutral about it because it feels like it does no harm or good to my skin. I am acne-prone as well and it does not cause any breakouts. When I use tretinoin or benzoyl peroxide my skin starts to pill and even after I put this moisturizer on my skin will still seem flaky and dry in those spots I put the ointment on. Overrall I do recommend for younger teens with combo/oily as a starting moisturizer product.

This is the product I’d really recommend as the best moisturizer! I’ve been using it for long now and I’ve also tried something like it that I bought from the drug store and it wasn’t anything like this! Ever since I started using Clinique my skin has been so much better.

i randomly came upon this product while searching for a hydrating moisturizer for my oily skin. it honestly has a really nice texture; it’s not greasy and glides on beautifully on my skin and does keep my skin plump and moisturized without the overly oily/greasy feel. i have really oily, acne prone skin and this doesn’t break me out. it also lasts for quite while too. i would definitely buy it again :)

I have combination oily skin and this product is great! I use it as part of the 3-step system and it soothes the skin after toning. It doesn’t leave my skin oily and absorbs quickly. Best of all, the large size has a pump that controls the amount that comes out. One pump usually does the trick for me. Best product for your money.

I have very oily skin and resisted trying this product again after initially using the Dramatically Different Moisturizing Lotion about 20 years ago. But Clinique has always priced their products decently, so on a whim I picked up the travel size of this while standing in line one day. The timing was perfect. I was looking for something that would moisturize my face without contributing to the oil production and this gel is definitely it, plus the price tag was just right. I use it morning and night after washing my face with a cleanser and it gives me just enough moisture to keep my skin soft without looking like an oil slick. I can even wake up in the morning and put off washing my face for a few hours if I happen to be lounging around the house. Before, I would get that nasty grimy feeling from the oil building up. Yuck! Kudos to Sephora for choosing their impulse buy products so well, and congratulations to Clinique for coming up with a moisturizer that works so well for oily skin!
best face cream for my oily acne prone skin!!!
I really like this product for my sensitive, acne prone skin. I just wish it had an SPF in it to protect.

I’ve been loyal to this moisturizer gel since I was in middle school... And now I’m a sophomore in college. I have combo oily and dry skin...this moisturizer is the most refreshing thing to ever put on my face. It absorbs within seconds and feels as if you’ve applied nothing, but it makes your skin noticeably smoother and less oily!!! Love love

I have combination skin and I used to use the lotion version but I didn’t like the new formula (it left my skin super greasy, heavy and prone to breakouts). I’m very glad I gave the gel a chance. I’ve only been using it for about a week and I’ve noticed my skin is no longer oily and the redness I used to have is now gone. The only down side is it isn’t moisturizing around my cheekbones so I have to use a little more there. Otherwise it’s a great product.
texture of moisturizer is excellent....may need to layer it a bit over drier areas during colder months. Overall, one of the best I’ve tried...
Best for oily skin. If you have some really dry patches it won’t help.

I’ve been using Clinique for years and have always loved the three step facial cleansing products. The moisturizing gel is perfect for my complicated skin type (combination) because it moisturizes the dry areas without making the rest of my face feel like a grease pit. If you have dry skin, stick with the moisturizing LOTION instead.

Best moisturizer ever. Love the gel texture - soaks right into my skin and you can really your skin “drinking“ it up persay. I wear this alone and under my makeup and have noticed a dramatic different within a week. My skin is so much softer and luminous. This is a must buy.
Definitely a great moisturizer for spring and summer. Leave your skin smooth and oil-free.

I really like this moisturizer for using under the make up. It is lightweight, provides good hydration and makeup applies great on top of it. It is not going to improve your skin or work some magic on your pores and dark spots, it is just a nice daytime moisturizer, that’s all. I usually buy it on sale and standard size 125ml lasts me all year.

I’ve tried other moisturizers (super high end to drugstore) and this is the one I always go back to. I’ve used it everyday for almost a year and it never fails to hydrate my skin but not leave it super oily or greasy. lovelovelove

I have oily/combination skin and finding a moisturizer has proven difficult. I bought this the other day at a friends recommendation. I applied in the evening before bed. Normally my skin will be a bit oily when I wake up but I was suprised by how soft my skin felt with no excess oil. I’m looking forward to seeing how this product effects my skin clarity/condition over the course of time.

I cannot get enough of this moisturizer. I can’t believe how fast it absorbs into my skin. I am a little oily in the T-zone and this moisturizer doesn’t at all add to the shiny-ness. I love how my face looks when I use this;and, I wish they would put an SPF into this product. This is one of my favorite Clinque items.

I tried these a few years back with the 3-step system but wasnt really impressed. I decided to try it again recently and didn’t see anything too amazing with it. It is a good basic moisturizer for quick hydration but doesnt provide any long term help.

I like this moisturizer. It does not break me out and the formula is lightweight like it states in the description. It absorbs fairly quickly and moisturizes well. It doesn’t make me less oily, but it is summer so I don’t expect it to stop that!
This product has helped with my oiliness in that it is more under control and not as problematic.
I love this product! Its great and moisturizes my skin wonderfully!:) all I have to say is that the gel is better and I have tried both the gel and the lotion( ps I have combination skin)

Every time I used this it caused minor breakouts.. I wanted to like this but no. It is very lightweight but something in it, my skin doesn’t agree with. I also didn’t find it as moisturizing as I would’ve liked. Will probably still finish the bottle since I paid for it , but wouldn’t repurchase

This stuff is amazing. I have combination skin that tends to get oily as the day goes on. This product keeps me moisturized and keeps me balanced. It stands up to my harsh acne treatments and keeps me soft and not oily.
I’ve used a lot of really expensive moisturizers, but this one is really great. It’s so lightweight, doesn’t have a strong smell and works well on my combination skin. If only there was SPF in it!

Been trying this out for the past month or so and I love it. I use it day and night and it helps keep my dry-combination skin matte. Sometimes I do use a bit more than usual because I feel like it does dry my face out a bit, so I just add a little more and it works. If you have oily or combo skin it’s a must, but if you have dry/combo skin you might need a little bit more.
I have combination skin and I have been pleased with this moisturizer. It hasn’t caused breakouts or increased oiliness in my T zone.

This works very well for oily/combination skin, though it would likely be drying for dryer skin. On my dry areas (forehead, jawbone) I may dab a little DD lotion, but the gel works just fine alone. I would buy this again.

I was hoping this would cure my dry skin and acne combo. It did not help with dryness at all. If anything I had to layer more creams overtop just to not feel any tightness in my cheeks, nose, and forehead. It also seems to clog my pores. I stopped using it on my face and now use it on my body so that I can finish the tub I bought.

i have really dry cracked skin that has even started causing me premature wrinkles (at only 20 yrs old!) and have been looking for an intensive moisturizer. ive tried tried many moisturizers for dry skin that claim not to clog pores but due to my sensitive skin this is the first one thats actually worked without making me break out or irritating my skin. it is rich andd creamy but lightweight and not greasy at all and leaves my skin softer and healthier than ever!
I think this is the best lotion I have ever used, definitely worth the price.

Wow! This cream is amazing. After searching everywhere drugstores, Bath and Body Works, Department stores.. I finally found something that deeply moisturizes my skin. It is light enough to use on my face doesn’t clog my pores, and it’s heavy enough to put on my body. I love this!

If you have eczema, RUSH OUT and buy this lotion. After the first use, my skin felt better. After the first week, I was only feverishly scratching my eczema patch once a day instead of ten times a day. After 2 weeks, I was no longer scratching but my patch was still noticeable. After one month, my patch is completely gone. The lotion does have an odd odor but it doesn’t linger. This is the only lotion which has ever cleared up my eczema.

I have acne and lots of scars and my skin is reddish.It is not like I like the smell 100% but it is ok. (it is better thanphilosophy one) It calms my skin, make is less redI apply this on my body as well

My favorite. Gives moisturize without leaving me greasy, goes great under the skin and is so gentle on my skin. I struggle with really dry skin (might even be developing eczema?) I put this on wherever my skin is dry and irritated in my body and it relives any kind of itchiness. I’ve repurchased maybe about 5 times. My boyfriend even has his own jar of this and he loves it, especially after shaving.

I got this in a holiday gift set so I figured: eh it doesn’t irritate my skin so I’ll give it a shot. This is BY FAR my new fave moisturizer! The first pic is my face at work: you can see my eczema is screaming at me. It was super irritated and awful. The second was after ONE USE of this stuff: no itchiness and so much relief all at once. I don’t even have to use that much of the product! Trust me, if you’re going to invest in a moisturizer and you have dry skin and eczema, this is BY FAR one of the best.
Just the right amount of moisture for my skin. Very light weight, never oily.

I can’t say enough good things about this product. I have been using in conjunction with the anti redness and my skin look great. It goes on smoothly and I look almost “dewy“ something that hadn’t happend in years! I highly recommend.
LIght and non-greasya little goes a long way. I use on my face but squeeze a little extra and use on my hands as well.Love it

i have sensitive skin and every moisturizer breaks me out. even though i have combination skin, this winter has left my skin flaky at times and this has helped without breaking me out!!! it’s very soothing without being greasy. thumbs up!

I decided to buy a full sized jar of this after trying a sample from Sephora. This is a great facial moisturizer for my combo, breakout prone skin. My face gets drier in the winter months and I needed to find something more moisturizing than my regular moisturizer...this fits the bill. And the tub is large for the price. V.happy w/this product.
I really love this product because it hydrates my face amazingly and totally natural.

I love this cream for my body and even neck! I love that it has no scent so it won’t ever compete with any perfume I may put on. The only drawback I found is that it claims it can go even on your face but it breaks my face out in a weird bubble rash so I can’t use it there. That’s ok cause I still love to use it everywhere else. Nice hydration and no stickiness afterwards!

I can’t believe I didn’t find this sooner. It completely saves my dry acne-prone skin. I’ve been using a topical treatment and one of the side effects is peeling and of course irritation. I’ve been using this cream over it and have found that it basically stops any bad side effects and I’ve had barely any peeling! Plus it doesn’t make me break out like most lotions. I highly recommend!

I’m really upset about my experience with this moisturizer. Back in April of last year, I bought this moisturizer and had the most wonderful experience. It lasted me a very long time as a little always went a long way. After the first batch though, I went to Sephora and bought more and the next day when I put it on my face, my skin no longer liked the product(maybe the second batch was a bad batch) which I found very odd. It feels like my face gets very tight and feels dry and gets very red. I thought maybe I damaged my skin in some way and it was just not working with my skin. However after about 3 months of not using the product, I went back. It still caused a lot of redness, makes my face feel tight and it feels dry. Overall thought the experience was good to begin with but I’m honestly not sure why my skin no longer likes it. I would recommend this product still as I know it works with most people’s skin. Just disappointed in my own experience:(

I do not have acne prone skin, but this made me break out terribly all over in just a week of use on my face.  I would not recommend for a face moisturizer.  I only bought because it was more affordable than what I typically use.  No other face moisturizers have caused breakout issues so I’m not sure what the problem ingredient was or if it was too heavy for the face.

This soothing, fragrance-free & easily penetraing cream was just the ticket for my parched, patchy winter skin. It’s a roomy jar & a little goes a long way, but it’s all-purpose & a delightful product to have in one’s dry skin arsenal. I love it.

On my 2nd jar and have the mini size. I love how hydrating this is, I started using this when i went on accutane (acne medicine) and it made my skin so dry. After i started using this my skin felt so hydrated

I may have already written a review for this cream but it is so good, I’ll write another. I have a tendency of picking at the clogged pores on my face which causes dry damaged skin. My solution is to glob this cream on at night (yes, I said glob, not light layer). It is so amazing at healing skin. If you have flaky dry skin, layer this stuff on thick before bed.

I just bought this a week ago. I usually use Philosophy hope in a jar and I love it. I wanted to try this because of the price. It’s thick and creamy. It makes my skin feel great! It made it very soft. The only thing I don’t like is that it takes a while for it to absorb. My hope in a jar absorbs immediately, but this takes 5-10 minutes before you can put makeup on. I decided it is better to use it at night. All in all, I like the results it gives so I will be keeping it because the price is worth it.
I love this moisturizer. It dealt with the dry, flaky skin on my nose and forehead without causing breakouts. It’s highly moisturizing but lightweight, and the jar is huge. Favorite!

I held off writing a review for a year so that I could test the product thoroughly. I originally purchased this after reading all the raving reviews, and I really wanted to love this as much as everyone else said they did. However, I was left disappointed each time I used it. To start off, as there are no added fragrances to cover up its underlying scent, it smells of strange chemical/plastic scent, which takes getting used to. As a moisturizer, it’s not moisturizing whatsoever. This product left my skin just as dry and flaky in the winter as it did in the summer. Furthermore, when rubbing the product into your skin, it would always flake up. Definitely don’t put this on in the morning, as the flaking makes makeup application troublesome. On the bright side, it did not break out my sensitive skin - however, it did absolutely nothing for it either, other than leave flaky residue. All in all, a terrible product that I would not recommend for anyone.
This is the only product that completely erase the dry patches I get during the winter. It is a must have for me. Great product

I use this moisturizer as an eye cream. I already have my tatcha moisturizer and my innisfree sunscreen to go along with it. I use my cetaphil cleanser to start out. This is a really great moisturizer and one of the best in the league. I never want to get rid of it. This is my forever friend. I have been using it for 3 years and counting.

Like many of us, my skin got super dry this winter and this was one of the few moisturizers that zapped the dry skin on my body. As odd as it sounds, I still get really dry on my sides under my bra and this is perfect to use in that area because it isn’t greasy. Unfortunately, it burned like crazy when I tried to use it on my face so I’m taking a star off. I don’t like the medicinal smell but it goes away after a few minutes. I am purchasing my third tub of the stuff.

I got this as a sample and I was glad because I’d been wanting to try it because of the reviews. Glad I got the sample and didn’t purchase this because I only used it once and it made me breakout, and it took a week for my skin to clear up. It felt sticky like it never completely dried, I hate that sticky feeling and moisturizers that leave a residue.

I have extremely sensitive, acne-prone, combination skin. I had been using this for a while for dry winter hands but gave it a shot for use on my face and I’ve never looked back. This has been my night cream for years and it’s the best I’ve ever used. Calms irritation, doesn’t break me out, intensely moisturizing. After moving to the desert from the Pacific Northwest I’ve started using this as my day cream as well and I couldn’t be happier. The big tube lasts me at least 6 months. Buy the big tube! Your wallet and skin will thank you.
Holy grail product! I’ve been using this moisturizer for so long and have never had any problems with it causing breakouts or anything. The best!

I like this cream as a final layer after I apply my night time retinoid. I also use it on my décolletage. It’s a rich but not oily cream. It stays tacky for a while after application, so it’s night time only for me.
I really wanted to love this product, but unfortunately I didn’t. It did not relieve my dry skin at all and it caused me to break out pretty severely. My face has not broken out like this in years.

My skin (face) got very dry as cold winter weather set in and yet I was breaking out at the same, I was feeling totally irritated. But I had gotten a sample of this stuff, so I tried it and it made my skin feel better immediately. I bought a tube and I pile it on before go running outdoors. And I love that it doesn’t have parabens in it.

This is my absolutel favourite product. So super absorbing, intensive and moisturizing. I love putting on every day, it makes my skin so soft. I have found nothing that compares. I feel like it saved my skin.

I have very dry hands almost year round. I wash my hands alot because I have young kids and I’m a cake decorator. I’m not fond of the smell but it leaves my hands feeling smooth without it feeling greasy or sticky.

This is my go to winter product. I’ve used it the last two winters and ready to purchase more when the weather starts cooling down again. I have oily acne prone skin that is very troublesome in the winter because it gets very dry and flaky while still turning greasy very quick. How lucky of me. Because of this some moisturizers leaves my skin burning after applying. The ultra repair cream doesn’t. First reason I’m so in love with it. Second, it is very moisturizing. I apply at night only so I don’t look like a total grease ball during the day. It also absorbs fairly quickly, very lightly scented, and a little goes a long way. I use this mainly on my face and haven’t experienced break out or clogged pores. This is going to be my third winter with this product and I can’t go without it now that I discovered it. Only thing that would make this better is to have the option of purchasing the larger sized in a tube.

My skin is very dry and rarely breaks out at all. My biggest challenging is finding cream that actually does the trick. This is added to my list of failures - it feels fairly thick to the touch, if even slightly greasy - but then is thin when you rub it in. About 5 minutes later, if feels like you never put cream on. To top it off, ever since I’ve been using, my skin has broken out a couple of times. I’m going to toss it.
I slather this on my face at the end of my routine. Perfect for dry skin.

I have psoriasis on my fingers and have used 4 prescription medications that have not worked. The cracking and bleeding was not only painful but left my fingers feeling numb and unusable. Got a sample of this with my Sephora package and after using it twice felt a difference so ordered the full size product. Since receiving it (and ordering two more jars) I haven’t had any cracking and the skin has returned to it’s normal color. Although I can still see some scaly spots my hands feel wonderful again. GREAT PRODUCT!!!
I love this product! It makes my skin so soft. My whole family uses this. I like this more than the tube!

I have never used such a soothing, moisturing cream. I use it daily after my shower on my driest areas. Nightly I apply it to my hands. I see a remarkable improvement in these areas. Even my cuticles and nails look better than they have in years. It is creamy with a light pleasant scent that disappears quickly. I have tried countless creams that never lived up to their descriptions. I am amazed and thrilled at the improvement I have seen after using this for a week. I bought a second jar so I could keep one in the bathroom and by my bed.
Great product.Instant relief to skin even overworked skin like from laser hair removal or electronic wrinkle remover. Highly recommend.

I have a REALLY red nose, not like faint pink when most girls say their face is red, but the worst sunburn you’ve had red. I’ve tried a lot of drugstore like garnier and aveeno, and lux products like tacha and clinique trying to help and nothing really did. My nose also gets really flaky as well but using purely moisturizing products just made my skin greasy. With some research i found this brand and decided to give it a shot. I got a value kit that had the Face Cleanser, Ultra Repair Cream and the Dry Hemp Oil (all first aid beauty) and it has been a live saver! Best thing I’ve ever tried. Doesn’t break me out (I also got the acne spot treatment gel and it works like a charm!), doesn’t feel greasy, my skin absorbs it immediately and my nose hasn’t been this calm in years! Even if you don’t have rosasea, eczema or anything like that its a great line of products! Will only be using products from this brand from now on! +Its all made in the USA!
I really wanted to love this product but, it made me break out all over my forehead. Also, I didn’t really see the difference in regards to hydration. Sticking to my regular moisturizer.
As an adult I have had spot acne at worst. This cream gave me one of the largest breakouts of my adult life. Stopped using this, and a day later my skin looked significantly better. Threw away.

This is the BEST moisturizer I’ve found. Living in such a dry state, I developed eczema. This is the only product that has worked-- and it’s completely healed my dry spots. It’s not oily or too much-- it’s light enough I can wear it during the day under my make up as well as night time without clogging my pores. I am so, so happy to have found this line because it’s been a lifesaver.
I got this for Christmas from my daughter i got the set. I wear this after I wash my face in the morning and night.  I wake up with my skin feeling soft and I love it

This is an amazing product.  This winter my normally oily, aging skin changed into extremely dry and irritated.  It was dry and red in spots.  Not good!  I tried this and it provided instant relief.  I use this with the FAB intense hydration serum and my skin looks better than ever.  Super balanced and calm.
Love this moisturizer! Leaves my skin feeling hydrated, but not too heavy. I am able to use it morning and night, even under makeup l.

I have acne prone, sensitive, dry skin and this product seemed to work very well with my skin! The product doesn’t just sit on the skin but it sinks into the skin. I still feel like it could be a little more moisturizing because sometimes my skin is worse in the winter
Did not work for me. Nice feel; a little thick. Made my skin break out and become bumpy and itchy. I was really hoping for better.

omg this clearer the texture on my forehead literally overnight. I’ve been looking for something that would help with this for so long!!! Definitely recommend if u have small bumps or texture on ur skin!

I LOVE this stuff. I have extremely acne prone skin, and I’m oilier than pretty much anyone (not “oh no my face gets kind of shiny“ oily, I’m talking “I have to use medication to control this“ oily) so it’s hard to find stuff that doesn’t make me feel even greasier. This stuff, though, is so nice that I replaced my regular moisturizer with it. It goes on matte and feels a lot like primer, very light and smooth. It doesn’t sting or dry my skin.I’m not sure if I’d recommend it as a moisturizer for people with more “regular“ skin, but if you’re a next level oilslick like me, drop your moisturizer for a bit and try this instead. The only reason I gave it four stars was because the bottle is so teeny tiny. I’d love a larger value option of this stuff so I don’t have to resort to buying two bottles at a time.
Helps even out my discoloration .
Used in combination with the Alpha Arbutin, this has helped with skin texture and lightening discoloration.  I also really like the texture, but it doesn’t play well when layering with oils.
Really helped to lighten hyperpigmentation! Do not mix with other acids.

I swear by this. It’s perfect for oily skin and helps to smooth out pores and fine lines. VERY MATTIFYING. It is a bit drying, so I recommend only using it in only spots like forehead, chin, and nose. Peas sized amount people! If you use too much/too thick it can give you a white cast if it’s not blended well

First impressions are mind blowing. In literally less than a week I’ve seen a smoothening effect on my skin and a little brightening. The wearability is amazing because it’s really  matifying. I haven’t used it long enough to comment on its true lightening ability though.
